blocks.intro: In May 2020, 7.35 inches of rain fell on Skokie in five days and the Deep Tunnel system reached capacity.

items.body: Most postwar basements have a floor drain tied straight to the sewer. In a big storm, it's the first opening water finds.
They need different fixes. We find out which you have.
Laundry rooms, rec rooms and storage turn a backup into real damage.

bodies: Some basement water is plumbing and some is the foundation. We handle the plumbing side: backflow valves, [overhead sewer systems](/skokie/overhead-sewer-systems), [sump pumps](/skokie/sump-pumps), battery backups and discharge lines.
If water is coming through cracks in the foundation, a waterproofing contractor is the right call, and we'll say so. In Skokie, fixing the sewer side first often solves more than people expect.

blocks.h2: Why Water Ponds on Skokie Streets
blocks.body: Skokie's flood control program is designed to hold water on the streets for up to four hours after rain stops. Holding it there keeps it out of the sewers long enough to protect many basements. So water in the street during a storm is often the system working. If your basement still takes on water, the cause is usually your lateral, your sump pump or a direct sewer connection that needs protection.

blocks.h2: Basement Flooding Questions From Skokie Homeowners

items.q: How do I know if it's sewer water?
items.preview: It comes up through the floor drain.
items.answer: If water rises through the floor drain or a basement toilet, it's usually sewer water. Water at the walls is groundwater.

items.q: What's the best way to stop sewer water in the basement?
items.preview: A backflow valve or an overhead sewer.
items.answer: A backflow valve or an overhead sewer system, depending on how you use the basement. We'll recommend one.

items.q: Do you clean up flooded basements?
items.preview: We fix the cause. Restoration companies dry and clean.
items.answer: We fix the plumbing that caused it. For drying and cleanup, a restoration company is the right call.

items.q: Will this happen every big storm?
items.preview: Possibly, until the basement is protected.
items.answer: If the cause was the sewer system filling up, it can happen again in the next big storm. Protection is what stops it.

items.q: Should I keep things on the basement floor?
items.answer: Use shelves or plastic bins to keep valuables off the floor.

items.q: How much does basement flooding repair cost in Skokie?
items.preview: It depends on the cause. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on the cause and what needs to be repaired or installed. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
